question: What claim about desire requires the speaker to wish now to hear from the gurus about the worship of the siddhas?
premises: The speaker has a present wish.
The object of hearing is the worship of the siddhas, to be heard from the gurus.
inference: Now the speaker wishes to hear from the gurus concerning the worship of the siddhas.
plain_english: Now I wish to hear from the gurus about the worship of the siddhas.
